_comment: Synthetic AAPL DAILY metrics snapshot, shaped like Sharadar DAILY datatable response. Used by NASDAQ-4 normalizer + NASDAQ-3 adapter tests. Numbers are illustrative public-market snapshots, not necessarily current.
_units: MONEY COLUMNS ARE USD MILLIONS, per the vendor's own column documentation for SHARADAR/DAILY (marketcap and ev are both documented 'USD millions'; verified against sharadar.com/docs/daily on 2026-09-04). The adapter multiplies by 1e6 at both DAILY call sites, which is CORRECT. This file previously held ABSOLUTE USD, which made the adapter look like it produced a market cap a million times too large and got the two tests below deselected from the battery for months. It was the FIXTURE that was wrong. A later wave inverted the adapter to match this file and would have shipped AAPL at USD 3.78M with every ticker scoring in the micro-cap bucket. Do not 'fix' the adapter to match a fixture: this file is declared synthetic, so its internal consistency proves only what its author assumed, never the wire format.
